ha_base_url.title: Home Assistant address
ha_base_url.description: Complete HTTP(S) address, including any port or path prefix. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not supported.

watch_entities.title: Entities to watch
watch_entities.description: Entity IDs separated by commas or newlines. The ordered union with action targets is limited to 32 entities; read selection alone never enables writes.

ha_token.title: Home Assistant token
ha_token.description: Required token for this plugin. Reads and explicitly selected button/scene actions use its existing Home Assistant account permissions.

action_entities.title: Buttons and scenes to control
action_entities.description: Optional explicit button.* and scene.* IDs, up to 16, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Leave blank for read-only use. These actions can control household devices.
